questions.question: Release proof: the two cases that show the new export path cannot be reached in a browser because of bugs that also exist on the main branch today. (1) A report with a missing chart never opens the editor, so the upload button can't be reached. (2) A bundle with more than 50 chart files is refused. The behaviour is proven by pipeline tests and database tests, and a reviewer approved it. How do you want it shipped?

options.label: Ship, label proof (Recommended)
options.description: Push both branches once (pipeline first). The notes say 'export path not proven in browser' and name the two blocking bugs. I run one browser check that a normal import still exports when the host is busy. The browser proof becomes part of the editor fix.

options.label: Hold until the editor fix
options.description: Keep both commits local. Fix the editor first in a new tab, then prove the export end to end in a browser, then push.

questions.question: Should we ship the image provenance change today, or should we wait until the editor bug is fixed and proven in a real browser?
